title: Project scope — the flow, project type, depth and glossary location a project is sized by
description: Written by skaileup. The file records what was decided and nothing else, so the top level is closed; every key is optional and an absent key reads as its default (tree/01_meta/scope.md § Format).

flow.description: The advisory recipe the project started from; orders skills and sizes nothing.

project_type.description: A row of tree/01_meta/scope.md § Project types; unset reads as web-app.

depth.description: Project-wide default for how far each artifact goes; absent reads as standard.

glossary.description: Where the words live (tree/glossary.md § Where the words live): `concept` keeps every definition in _concept/glossary.md; any other value is the project-relative path of the project glossary, with no leading / and no .. segment. Absent reads as CONTEXT.md when the project root has one, else concept.

reasoning.description: Two to six sentences naming which signals decided the keys.

proposed.description: Entries a non-owner skill appended for an absent key; skaileup confirms or rejects them (tree/01_meta/scope.md § Asking a missing key).

chosen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the latest change.

signals.description: Each answer as the user gave it; the reasoning quotes these values.

features_estimate.description: How many distinct things a user can do.

multi_user.description: Whether more than one role shares state.

persistence.description: How data is persisted: none, one relational schema, or an external store the project does not own.

source.description: The user's words or an evidence reference.
